content: svelte.dev/docs/svelte/testing still documents plain mount()-based component tests under Vitest as the baseline and mentions @testing-library/svelte (5.4.2) as an optional ergonomics layer. vitest-browser-svelte reached 3.0.0 (2026-07-09) and requires vitest >=4.0.0 plus Vitest Browser Mode (@vitest/browser 4.1.10 / @vitest/browser-playwright) — it replaces jsdom with real Playwright browsers. Migration cost: swap jsdom for browser mode, rewrite setup files, convert querySelector assertions to locators. Not a drop-in addition.
